notes.title: 100 KILLS CHALLENGE will be released on April 15th PT.
notes.notes: 100 KILLS CHALLENGE will be released on April 15th PT. In view of the large number of players' feedback that the Bot is too powerful, the official version will be slightly adjusted. As for the full version, players can experience the team deathmatch mode, which can be said to be a completely different game from the deathmatch mode. In addition, there are a large number of weapons waiting for players to unlock, and more small maps for players to experience. Players can complete a large number of kills in a short period of time! In terms of gameplay, killing and chaos are the positioning of this game, so the game is full of bullets, grenades, bomber bombings, helicopter strafing, and all kinds of inexplicable killings and be killings. Please understand! We look forward to having you play this game!
